claim: A roster of public elliptic-curve challenges and where a distinguished-point walk for each one would go. A row is not a discrete-log recovery and is not a statement about the security of any deployed curve.

groups.title: Certicom Koblitz challenges
groups.summary: Binary Koblitz curves from the Certicom ECC Challenge. Only ECC2K-130 has a distinguished-point store on this site.

challenges.name: ECC2K-95
challenges.join: A walk has to use this curve's field and generator. The ECC2K-130 client does not produce points for it, and this site has no store for them.

challenges.name: ECC2K-108
challenges.join: A walk has to use this curve's field and generator. The ECC2K-130 client does not produce points for it, and this site has no store for them.

challenges.name: ECC2K-130
challenges.join: This is the production walk. Use the ECC2K-130 GPU client, pick a run id in 10000–65534 that nobody else is walking, and keep the points until a public upload exists. The fleet's own store is the only corpus the status page counts.

challenges.name: ECC2K-163
challenges.join: No distinguished-point store on this site. Points from an ECC2K-130 walk do not belong to this curve.

challenges.name: ECC2K-238
challenges.join: No distinguished-point store on this site. Points from an ECC2K-130 walk do not belong to this curve.

groups.title: Research curve catalog
groups.summary: 263 research instances in aburan28/cryptanalysis, challenges/ecc. They are not the Certicom parameter sets. Prime-field short-Weierstrass records can start a local rho job; the points stay on that machine.

challenges.name: Binary Koblitz
challenges.join: Includes f2-koblitz-a0-m131, the same equation family as ECC2K-130. A catalog record is not a second copy of the live store. ca-curves show <id> prints the record.

challenges.name: Binary, not Koblitz
challenges.join: Index-calculus inputs in the catalog. No distinguished-point store on this site.

challenges.name: Binary, defined over a subfield
challenges.join: No distinguished-point store on this site.

challenges.name: Binary supersingular
challenges.join: No distinguished-point store on this site.

challenges.name: Prime field, complex multiplication
challenges.join: ca-curves rho-job <id> --seed 1 writes a job with the curve, generator, and target, and without a known logarithm. ca-suite rho-collab work --job <file> --node local walks it on that machine.

challenges.name: Prime field, j = 0
challenges.join: Same local rho-job path as the other prime-field short-Weierstrass records. Points are not uploaded to the ECC2K-130 store.

challenges.name: Prime field, j = 1728
challenges.join: Same local rho-job path. Points are not uploaded to the ECC2K-130 store.

challenges.name: Prime field, random j
challenges.join: Same local rho-job path. Points are not uploaded to the ECC2K-130 store.

challenges.name: Prime field, anomalous
challenges.join: Trace 1. Same local rho-job path. An anomalous curve is not a license to treat the walk as a Smart attack; the job is ordinary rho.

challenges.name: Prime field, supersingular
challenges.join: Same local rho-job path. Points are not uploaded to the ECC2K-130 store.

challenges.name: Prime field, j = 0 twists
challenges.join: Same local rho-job path. Points are not uploaded to the ECC2K-130 store.

challenges.name: Prime field, smooth order
challenges.join: Same local rho-job path. Points are not uploaded to the ECC2K-130 store.

challenges.name: Barreto–Naehrig sample
challenges.join: Same local rho-job path. Points are not uploaded to the ECC2K-130 store.

challenges.name: Odd-characteristic extensions
challenges.join: Index-calculus inputs. rho-job does not cover extension records.

challenges.name: Characteristic 3
challenges.join: Ordinary and supersingular. No distinguished-point store on this site.

challenges.name: Isogeny volcano exhibit
challenges.join: fp-volcano-d7-l3-exhibit records a rational 3-volcano. It is not a rho campaign.
